# `aitbc node island list`

List all known islands (alias for list-islands).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node island list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-url` | text | `http://127.0.0.1:8202` | no | Local node RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node island list
```
